t: 俄罗斯开始使用安诺多米尼时代来代替拜占庭帝国的安诺蒙迪时代.
te: Russia begins using the Anno Domini era instead of the Anno Mundi era of the Byzantine Empire.
dz: 俄罗斯开始使用安诺多米尼时代来代替拜占庭帝国的安诺蒙迪时代.
de: Russia begins using the Anno Domini era instead of the Anno Mundi era of the Byzantine Empire.

t: 8.7–9.2 Mw Cascadia地震发生在北美西海岸外,由日本的记录所证明.
te: The 8.7–9.2 Mw Cascadia earthquake takes place off the west coast of North America, as evidenced by Japanese records.
dz: 8.7–9.2 Mw Cascadia地震发生在北美西海岸外,由日本的记录所证明.
de: The 8.7–9.2 Mw Cascadia earthquake takes place off the west coast of North America, as evidenced by Japanese records.
